canonical.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
canonical.sourceFilePath: 11. Binary Trees/3. Hard/08. Construct BT from inorder and preorder.cpp

narrative.title: Rebuilding the Supply Route Blueprint
narrative.scenario: A logistics planner lost the org chart of a distribution tree but kept two audit logs: a hub-first walk (each hub recorded before its branches) and a left-first walk (each branch recorded before its hub). Because no two hubs share a name, the two logs together pin down every split point, and the blueprint can be rebuilt exactly.
narrative.inputFormat: Two integer arrays — preorder (root, left subtree, right subtree) and inorder (left subtree, root, right subtree) of the same tree. Values are unique.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the constructed binary tree serialized as a level-order array (null marks a missing child, trailing nulls trimmed).

testCases.explanation: 3 roots the tree; 9 is its lone left child, and 20 heads the right subtree over 15 and 7.
1 is the root, 2 its left child, 3 its right child.

hintLevels: Level 1: The first preorder value is always the current root — the inorder array then tells you how many nodes hang left of it.
Level 2: Split both arrays at the root's inorder position; each fragment is an independent smaller copy of the same problem.
Level 3: Index the root's inorder position up front and consume preorder left-to-right so each node is placed exactly once.
